devohmycode-skills-atlas-skills-atlas.description: Find, compare, read, install, update and uninstall public Agent Skills (SKILL.md) from a catalog of about 75,000, with the skills-atlas CLI. Use when the user wants a skill for some task ("is there a skill for…", "find me a skill to…"), asks what skills are installed or outdated, wants to install, update or remove skills for one or several agents, or to copy their skills to another machine or project.
